ground_truth: The minimum age to open a standard savings account at Apex Global Bank is 18 years. Minors aged 0–17 years can open a Junior/Minor account but must be represented by a legal guardian.
Online applications are usually processed within 24 hours. Branch applications can result in instant accounts within 30 minutes.
Only Student and Salary accounts allow for a $0 initial deposit. All other account tiers require a minimum initial funding — Basic requires $100, Premium requires $2,500, and Elite requires $10,000.

To open a savings account, you need: a primary ID (Passport, National ID, Driver's License, or State-issued ID), an address verification document (utility bill within 90 days, lease agreement, mortgage statement, or another bank's statement), two 2x2 color photographs, and a Tax Identification Number (TIN/SSN/PAN) for interest-bearing accounts.
The initial deposit required for a Premium Savings account is $2,500.

The Elite Savings account is designed for High-Net-Worth (HNW) individuals. It requires an initial funding of $10,000, maintains a minimum AMB of $25,000, and provides access to wealth management and priority banking services.

Yes, expatriates and non-residents can open a savings account at Apex Global Bank. They must provide a valid work permit or residency visa with at least 6 months remaining validity. They are also subject to FATCA and CRS protocols.

V-KYC (Video KYC) for digital account opening involves four steps: filling out the e-form, completing an AI-driven liveness check with facial recognition, a 2-minute video call with a certified bank officer to verify original documents in real-time, and signing digitally via e-signature technology.

If an account has no transactions for 24 months, it is classified as Dormant and subject to a full block on all transactions. To reactivate it, the customer must submit a written request, provide updated KYC documents (proof of address), and complete biometric verification at the home branch.
Yes, all deposits at Apex Global Bank are insured up to $250,000 or the local equivalent by the National Deposit Insurance Corporation.

No, a 17-year-old cannot open a savings account independently. Minors aged 0–17 years must be represented by a legal guardian. However, a Junior/Minor account can be opened on their behalf, which is guardian-controlled and designed for educational savings.

An Inactive account has had no transactions for 12 months and faces restricted withdrawals. A Dormant account has had no transactions for 24 months and is subject to a full block on all transactions. Reactivating a dormant account requires a written request, updated KYC documents, and biometric verification at the home branch.
The non-maintenance penalty for a Basic Savings account is $5 per month if the Average Monthly Balance falls below the required $500.

New savings account holders get access to the ApexOne Digital Suite which includes Mobile Banking on iOS and Android, Wealth Tracking dashboard, Card Controls to lock/unlock debit cards, and a Personal Finance Manager (PFM) for automated spending categorization.
The initial deposit for a Student Savings account is just $10, and there is no minimum AMB requirement, making it a zero-balance account with no non-maintenance penalties.

Apex Global Bank offers six account types: Basic Savings for entry-level earners for everyday transactions; Premium Savings for mid-career professionals for wealth accumulation; Elite Savings for High-Net-Worth individuals for wealth management; Student Savings for enrolled students aged 18–25 for financial literacy; Junior/Minor accounts for children under 18 for educational savings (guardian-controlled); and Salary Savings for corporate employees for direct deposit payroll processing.
During branch account opening, biometric capture includes fingerprint or iris scan for internal records.

Yes, the bank can close an account with 30 days' notice for the following reasons: consistently falling below the minimum balance, suspicious activity not cleared by compliance, or failure to provide updated KYC information.

Sanctions screening is a mandatory step during account opening where the applicant's details are verified against UN, OFAC, and local government watchlists to ensure the bank is not used for money laundering, terrorism financing, or other illegal activities.
The fee for outbound international wire transfers from a savings account is $35 per transaction.
The Average Monthly Balance (AMB) required for a Basic Savings account is $500.

The Average Monthly Balance (AMB) is calculated by summing the closing balance of the account for every day of the calendar month and dividing that total by the number of days in that month. For example, if a customer has $1,000 for 15 days and $0 for the remaining 15 days in a 30-day month, their AMB is $500.
The penalty for a Premium Savings account if the AMB falls below $5,000 is a flat fee of $25.00 per month.
The Average Monthly Balance (AMB) requirement for Elite Savings accounts is $25,000. If the AMB falls below this, a flat fee of $100.00 per month is charged.
No. Student accounts and Salary accounts are zero-balance accounts with no AMB requirement and will never incur non-maintenance penalties.

No. Apex Global Bank uses the Average Monthly Balance (AMB) method, not a minimum daily balance. Falling below the limit for a single day does not automatically trigger a penalty. As long as your average balance across the whole month stays above the requirement, no fee is charged.
Your shortfall is $100 out of the required $500, which is a 20% shortfall. Since the shortfall is less than 25%, you will be charged the lowest penalty tier of $2.00 per month.
The maximum non-maintenance fee for a Basic Savings account is $5.00 per month, which applies when the shortfall exceeds 50% of the required $500 AMB.
Yes. If a customer's balance is trending toward a shortfall, the bank will send an SMS and email alert on the 20th of the month to allow for corrective action before the penalty is applied.
Senior citizens aged 60 and above receive a 50% discount on all non-maintenance penalties at Apex Global Bank.

The dormancy processing fee is $10.00 as a one-time fee when an account transitions from Inactive to Dormant status.

Yes. If you close your account, no further maintenance fees will apply once the closure process is finalized. However, any accrued penalties for the current month must be settled before closure can be completed.

KYC stands for Know Your Customer. It is a mandatory process of identifying and verifying the identity of clients at the time of account opening and periodically over time. It is required to ensure the bank is not used for money laundering or illegal activities, to protect financial identities from theft and fraud, and to ensure the bank understands the customer's financial profile and source of funds.

For KYC, you need a government-issued photo ID such as a Passport, National Identity Card, Driver's License, or Voter ID. You also need an address proof document such as a utility bill (not more than 3 months old), property tax receipt, bank statement, or registered lease agreement. A Tax Identification Number (TIN/SSN/PAN) is also required for interest-bearing accounts.

Yes. You can complete KYC online using the ApexOne App's Video-KYC (V-KYC) feature. It takes approximately 5 minutes and requires you to have your original ID cards ready for the camera. The process involves OTP-based authentication, a live video interaction with a bank official, and real-time facial matching and geo-tagging.
High-risk customers must update their KYC every 2 years. Medium-risk customers must update every 8 years, and low-risk customers every 10 years.

If you don't update your KYC, your account will be progressively restricted. First, outbound transactions (transfers, ATM withdrawals) are blocked (Partial Freeze). Then both inbound and outbound transactions are blocked (Full Freeze). If KYC remains pending for 6 months after a full freeze, the bank reserves the right to close the account and issue a manager's check for the remaining balance.

Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) is a heightened level of customer verification applied to high-risk categories including Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) and their associates, customers from high-risk jurisdictions, High-Net-Worth Individuals (HNIs) with complex wealth structures, and non-resident customers.
The bank will send notifications via SMS, email, and push notifications 3 months before your KYC expiry date. You can also check your KYC status in the Profile section of the mobile app.

Partial KYC is used for Small Accounts or instant wallets. These accounts have restricted balances of up to $1,000 and a limited validity of 12 months. Full KYC allows unrestricted account operations and access to all bank products.
Yes. If the Identity Proof document contains the current address, it can serve as both ID and address proof simultaneously, eliminating the need for a separate address proof document.

Simplified Due Diligence (SDD) is the lowest level of KYC verification, applied to low-risk customers such as public authorities or publicly listed companies. Documentation requirements are minimal compared to standard or enhanced due diligence.

You must update your records within 30 days of moving. If there is no change in name, you can update via the ApexOne App or by emailing self-attested scanned copies. For major profile updates, a branch visit is required. You will need a valid proof of your new address.
The Video KYC (V-KYC) process takes approximately 5 minutes through the ApexOne App and requires the customer to have their original ID cards ready for the camera.
Medium-risk customers are required to update their KYC every 8 years.

Standard Customer Due Diligence (CDD) is the baseline KYC process for all individual retail customers requiring full verification of identity and permanent address. Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) is applied to high-risk categories like Politically Exposed Persons, customers from high-risk jurisdictions, high-net-worth individuals with complex wealth structures, and non-residents — requiring deeper scrutiny of the customer's financial profile and source of funds.
No. Apex Global Bank will never share KYC documents with unauthorized third parties. Data may only be shared for regulatory reporting or credit bureau assessments as required by law.

The minimum annual income required for the Apex Classic credit card for a resident salaried individual is $15,000.
The standard APR on Apex Global Bank credit cards is 3.5% per month, which equals 42% per annum. Preferred APR rates of 1.5%–2.5% per month are available for customers with credit scores above 800.

If you miss payment for 90 days, the account is classified as a Non-Performing Asset (NPA) and legal proceedings are initiated. Before that, on Day 30 the account is marked Past Due Date and credit bureau reporting begins, and on Day 60 card privileges are temporarily suspended.
The Minimum Amount Due (MAD) is typically 5% of the total outstanding balance plus any applicable taxes, fees, or EMI installments.

A salaried applicant must be employed for a minimum of 6 months in their current job, with a total career experience of at least 1 year, and must be employed by a registered corporate, government body, or reputed MNC.
Applicants with a credit score below 650 (Tier 4) face automatic rejection unless they are part of a secured credit program.
Yes, freelancers are treated as self-employed individuals. You must provide 2 years of tax returns and bank statements showing consistent professional credits to qualify for a credit card.
Cash advances on Apex credit cards accrue interest immediately at 3.99% per month with no grace period.
The over-limit fee on an Apex Global Bank credit card is $25 per instance when the credit limit is exceeded.
The foreign currency markup on Apex Global Bank credit cards ranges from 2.0% to 3.5% depending on the card variant.

While 750 is the preferred credit score for a Platinum card, a score of 720 may still be considered if your income is significantly above the threshold or if you have a long-standing relationship with AGB. It is not an automatic rejection but approval is not guaranteed.
The minimum annual income for the Apex Infinite card is $200,000 for resident salaried individuals, $250,000 for resident self-employed individuals, and $350,000 for expatriates.
After 6 months of disciplined usage, you can apply for a credit limit increase via the ApexOne App by providing updated income proof.
A DTI (Debt-to-Income) ratio below 30% is ideal. A DTI between 30%–45% is subject to senior underwriter review. A DTI above 45% is prohibited for new unsecured credit lines.

The Apex Reserve is the top-tier credit card offered by Apex Global Bank. It is available by invitation only, regardless of whether you are a resident salaried individual, self-employed, or an expatriate.

Apex Global Bank credit cards are protected by EMV Chip & PIN technology, tokenization for digital wallet transactions (Apple Pay/Google Pay), and mandatory 3D Secure second-factor authentication for all online transactions.
A self-employed business owner must have a minimum of 3 years of business vintage in the same line of business to qualify for a credit card at Apex Global Bank.
Apex Classic and Gold cardholders can convert purchases over $250 into EMI installments over 6 to 24 months.
Credit bureau reporting is initiated when the account is marked Past Due Date (PDD) on Day 30 of non-payment.
Apex Infinite cardholders receive unlimited lounge access as part of their travel benefits, along with multi-trip travel insurance up to $1 million and 24/7 global lifestyle concierge services.

A salaried credit card applicant must provide the last 3 months' salary slips with a break-up, the latest 2 years of tax return forms (Form 16/ITR), and the last 6 months' bank statement showing salary credits.
Recovery agents are prohibited from contacting customers before 08:00 (8 AM) or after 19:00 (7 PM). No harassment or breach of privacy is tolerated under AGB's Code of Commitment to Customers.
For salaried individuals, the maximum age is 65 years at the time of card expiry. For self-employed individuals, the maximum age is 70 years at card expiry.

Yes, expatriates can apply for the Apex Gold credit card. The minimum annual income required for expatriates for the Apex Gold card is $60,000. They must also have a valid residence permit/visa with at least 12 months of validity remaining and a stable local employment contract.
Apex Classic and Gold cardholders receive a 1% fuel surcharge waiver at all domestic fuel stations.
The Apex Infinite card offers 5x reward points on international spend along with luxury brand partnerships as part of its high-tier benefits.
The joining/annual fee for Apex credit cards ranges from $0 to $500 depending on the card variant and is waived based on annual spend milestones.

The real-time Fraud Management System (FMS) monitors transactions for velocity checks (too many transactions in a short time), high-risk merchant categories, and geographic anomalies such as a card being used in two different countries within an hour.
Approximately 40% of credit card applications are Straight-Through Processed (STP) by the Automated Credit Decisioning (ACD) engine without manual intervention.
Customers with credit scores above 800 are eligible for a preferred APR of 1.5% to 2.5% per month, compared to the standard rate of 3.5% per month.

A Key Fact Statement (KFS) is a document provided to borrowers detailing the total cost of the loan or credit, including the APR and processing fees, ensuring full transparency and no hidden charges as per the Fair Practice Code.
Self-employed professionals such as doctors, chartered accountants, and engineers must have a minimum of 2 years of practice in their current field to be eligible for a credit card.
The duplicate statement fee for a credit card is $5 per request.
The minimum annual income required for the Apex Platinum card for a resident self-employed individual is $100,000.

Zero liability protection means that if an unauthorized transaction is reported within 72 hours and no negligence is found on the customer's part, the customer bears no financial liability for the fraudulent transaction. Apex Classic and Gold cards include this protection.
The minimum annual income required for an expatriate to apply for the Apex Platinum credit card is $120,000.
Tier 2 corresponds to a credit score range of 700–749, which results in standard processing for credit card applications.
Apex Global Bank pulls credit data from leading bureaus including CIBIL, Experian, and Equifax for the External Credit Bureau Assessment.
Platinum and Signature debit cardholders receive up to $50,000 Accidental Death coverage and $500 Purchase Protection against theft or damage of items bought within 30 days.
The daily ATM withdrawal limit for a Classic (Basic) Debit Card is $500.

You can activate your new debit card by setting a Green PIN through three methods: via the ApexOne mobile app under Cards > Manage Card > Set PIN, at any AGB ATM by selecting 'Generate Green PIN' using the OTP sent to your registered mobile, or through Net Banking under the Cards tab using Instant PIN Generation.
The daily POS and online purchase limit for a Signature (Elite) Debit Card is $25,000.

You can block your debit card immediately using three methods: through the ApexOne App using the Permanent Block toggle under Card Settings, by sending an SMS with BLOCK followed by the last 4 digits of your card to 56767, or by calling the 24/7 emergency hotline at 1-800-APEX-HELP.
The contactless (tap) limit for a Platinum (Premium) Debit Card is $100 per transaction, subject to local regulatory caps.

A new personalized debit card takes 3 to 5 business days to be delivered to metro areas. For regional or rural areas it takes 7 to 10 business days, and for international addresses it takes 10 to 15 business days.
The minimum age for a personalized debit card is 15 years. For children aged 7–14, a Junior Card can be issued, linked to a guardian's account with restricted limits.

No. New debit cards are enabled for domestic usage only by default. Customers must manually enable international usage and online (e-commerce) transactions via the ApexOne mobile app to prevent unauthorized cross-border fraud.
A markup fee of 2.5% applies to all international debit card transactions for currency conversion.
You earn 1 Apex Point for every $5 spent on POS and online transactions using your debit card.
After reporting an unauthorized transaction, the bank will investigate with the merchant and network. The standard resolution time for debit card chargebacks is 45 to 60 days.

You must report an unauthorized debit card transaction within 72 hours. If reported within 72 hours and no negligence is found on your part, you are not liable for the loss under the Zero Liability policy.
Platinum and Signature debit cardholders receive complimentary quarterly visits to domestic airport lounges.
Yes. Through the ApexOne app, you can use the Temporary Lock feature to instantly disable the card if misplaced, and unlock it when found, without needing to request a replacement card.
The Classic Debit Card provides $1,000 Accidental Death Cover as part of its insurance benefits.
The daily POS and online purchase limit for a Platinum (Premium) Debit Card is $10,000.

For new accounts, the debit card is triggered automatically upon successful KYC verification. Cards can be issued instantly at select Digital Experience branches, or personalized cards with the customer's name are dispatched within 48 hours.
The contactless (tap and pay) limit for a Signature (Elite) Debit Card is $200 per transaction, subject to local regulatory caps.
Yes. Through the ApexOne app's Merchant Category Blocking feature, you can restrict usage at specific types of merchants, including gambling sites and international sites.
You should never share your PIN, CVV, or OTP with anyone, including bank staff. Apex Global Bank will never call you to ask for your card details.
If you close your account between 15 days and 1 year of opening, a $20.00 administrative fee applies. If closed within the first 14 days (Free Look period), there is no charge.
No. Account closure after 1 year is completely free of charge. The $20.00 fee only applies if you close the account between 15 days and 1 year of opening.
No. All linked credit facilities including loans, overdrafts, and credit card dues must be fully settled or transferred to another account before a savings or current account can be closed.
Account closure takes 3 to 5 business days from the date of the closure request.
Remaining funds are transferred to an external account via wire transfer or issued via a Manager's Check.

Digital closure requests via the ApexOne App are available only for zero-balance accounts. If you have funds remaining or physical checkbooks, you must visit your home branch to complete the surrender process and collect your final payout.

You can update your registered mobile number at any AGB ATM or via the Mobile App using Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). Note that changing a registered mobile number will temporarily disable high-value digital transfers for 24 hours for security.

No. Due to high fraud risk, name changes cannot be performed digitally. A physical visit to the home branch with original documents is mandatory. Required documents include a Marriage Certificate, Divorce Decree, or Government Gazette notification.
Upon account closure, your data will be archived for 10 years as per regulatory record-keeping mandates.

The bank can initiate account closure under three conditions: KYC non-compliance after a 6-month full freeze, verified involvement in fraudulent or illegal transactions, or continuous zero balance with no activity for 24 months (for basic accounts).
For a manual address change at the branch, you need a valid Proof of Address such as a utility bill, lease agreement, etc., along with a signed declaration. The update takes 24 to 48 hours.
If your new address proof is a National ID linked to a mobile OTP, the address change can be done instantly via the ApexOne App. Manual branch updates take 24 to 48 hours.
After a name change, a new Debit Card will be issued automatically with standard replacement fees applied.
Yes. If you close your account within the first 14 days of opening, there is no charge — this is called the Free Look period.
Before closing your account, you must return or destroy all physical instruments including unused checkbook leaves and active Debit Cards, which must be cut across the chip.
Changing a registered mobile number will temporarily disable high-value digital transfers for 24 hours as a security measure.
The fee for an address change done physically at a branch is $5.00. The address change is free if done via the Mobile App.

Since you opened the account 3 months ago (between 15 days and 1 year), a $20.00 administrative closure fee applies. You will need to ensure the account balance is zero, settle any outstanding fees or penalties, surrender or destroy your checkbook leaves and debit card (cut across the chip), and visit your home branch. Any remaining funds will be transferred via wire or issued as a Manager's Check. Processing takes 3 to 5 business days.

A Power of Attorney (PoA) account allows a family member to operate a bank account for an elderly relative. The PoA must be legally notarized and verified by the bank's legal team. Digital access is generally not granted to PoA holders — they must operate via branch-based requests only.

If no nominee is registered, a Succession Certificate or Letter of Administration is mandatory to claim funds from a deceased depositor's account. If a nominee is registered, funds are released upon submission of a Death Certificate and Nominee ID.

You can file a complaint through multiple channels: in-person at the nearest AGB branch, by calling the 24/7 toll-free helpline at 1-800-APEX-CARE, by emailing support@apexglobalbank.com, through the ApexOne App under Menu > Help & Support > Raise a Ticket, or via Direct Message on the bank's official social media handles on X (Twitter) or Facebook for non-sensitive assistance.

A Ticket Reference Number (TRN) is a unique identifier issued to every customer when their grievance is recorded. It can be used to track the status of your complaint and is required when escalating the issue to higher levels.
For digital transaction error complaints, acknowledgement is provided within 24 hours and the resolution time is 7 business days.
Credit card disputes are acknowledged within 48 hours and have a resolution time of 15 to 45 business days due to the complexity of the investigation process.
No. Apex Global Bank provides all grievance redressal services completely free of charge to all account holders.

You can approach the Banking Ombudsman after 30 days of filing the initial complaint if the bank has failed to resolve it satisfactorily, or if the bank's final response is unsatisfactory. Regulations typically require giving the bank at least 30 days to resolve the issue internally before the Ombudsman will accept the case.

The Nodal Officer is a Level 2 escalation point — a Regional Nodal Officer for your specific zone. You can escalate to them at nodal.officer@apexglobalbank.com if the Level 1 resolution is unsatisfactory or not received within the stipulated time. The Nodal Officer's response time is 7 business days.

To file a complaint, you need to provide your full name and registered mobile number, your account number or credit card number (masked or last 4 digits only), the transaction date and reference number if applicable, and a brief description of the grievance.
General inquiries are acknowledged immediately and have a resolution time of 48 hours.

The Principal Nodal Officer (PNO) is the Level 3 escalation point located at the Corporate Headquarters. If you remain dissatisfied with the Nodal Officer's decision, you can contact the PNO at pno@apexglobalbank.com. The PNO's response time is 10 business days.
Staff behavior or service-related complaints are acknowledged within 24 hours and have a resolution time of 5 business days.
Account opening and KYC issue complaints are acknowledged within 24 hours and have a resolution time of 3 business days.

As a customer, you have the Right to be Heard — every grievance must be recorded and acknowledged via a unique TRN. The bank maintains strict confidentiality of your personal details during investigation. You are responsible for providing accurate information and refraining from abusive language.

Since your complaint has been pending for more than 30 days without resolution, you are now eligible to approach the Banking Ombudsman, an independent regulatory body. You can also escalate internally through the Nodal Officer at nodal.officer@apexglobalbank.com using your original Ticket Reference Number (TRN), and then to the Principal Nodal Officer at pno@apexglobalbank.com if still unsatisfied.
The 24/7 toll-free helpline for customer complaints is 1-800-APEX-CARE.

Most failed transactions are auto-reversed within 24 to 48 hours. If the funds are not returned after 3 business days, you should raise a ticket via the Grievance Redressal portal with your transaction reference ID.
If you have an active Debit Card, visit the AGB website, click Register, and enter your card details along with the OTP sent to your registered mobile number.
You can send money internationally via the Global Wire section in Net Banking. You will need the recipient's IBAN or Account Number and the SWIFT/BIC code of the destination bank.

If a customer reports a scam, staff should immediately freeze the account and initiate the Zero Liability dispute process. For lost or stolen cards, staff must prioritize these calls, authenticate via date of birth and Mother's Maiden Name, then block the card immediately.

You can find the nearest branch or ATM using the Branch Locator tool in the ApexOne App or by visiting the AGB website. The bank's network includes over 5,000 ATMs globally that are free for AGB customers.

Never click on links in SMS or emails that ask for your banking credentials. You should check the Last Login timestamp every time you enter Net Banking and report any suspicious emails immediately through the grievance portal.
Apex Global Bank recommends changing your banking password every 90 days for security. You should also enable biometric login on the ApexOne App.
The IT Support contact is helpdesk@apexbank.int with internal extension 101.
Bank staff should never ask a customer for their PIN or CVV under any circumstances. They must also not share customer data with other departments without a business need.
For emergency card hotlisting, contact emergency.cards@apexbank.int with internal extension 999.
Staff must verify the customer's identity before discussing any account details. They should greet the customer by their preferred name and use plain language, avoiding complex banking jargon.
Apex Global Bank's network includes over 5,000 ATMs globally, all free to use for AGB customers.
For lost or stolen card calls, staff must authenticate the customer via their date of birth and Mother's Maiden Name before blocking the card. These calls are to be prioritized over other queries.

Staff must provide a Ticket Reference Number (TRN) for every complaint raised. They must also verify the customer's identity before discussing account details and use plain language throughout the interaction.
For treasury and forex rate queries, contact forex.desk@apexbank.int with internal extension 302.

The five basic rights under the RBI Charter as upheld by Apex Global Bank are: Right to Fair Treatment (no discrimination), Right to Transparency and Honest Dealing (clear terms and conditions), Right to Suitability (only appropriate products offered), Right to Privacy (personal data kept confidential), and Right to Grievance Redressal (structured, time-bound dispute resolution).

No. Per RBI guidelines and internal policy, any upward revision in service charges or changes in terms and conditions must be communicated to you at least 30 days in advance via your registered email or SMS.
Apex Global Bank uses AES-256 encryption for all data at rest and in transit, complying with the Information Technology Act and RBI's Cyber Security Framework.
Customer liability for unauthorized electronic transactions is limited to zero if the breach is reported within 3 working days, as per the RBI Circular on Limited Liability.
No. Apex Global Bank follows a consent-based sharing policy. No customer data is shared with third-party marketers without explicit opt-in consent from the customer.

The Fair Practice Code (FPC) is a voluntary set of standards ensuring ethical conduct across all retail banking operations. It covers loan and credit transparency with no hidden charges, a Key Fact Statement for all loans, 30-day advance notice for rate changes, and non-discriminatory lending based solely on financial merit.

Apex Global Bank conducts Quarterly Compliance Audits to verify adherence to interest rate caps and fee disclosures, along with Mystery Shopping to test service quality and periodic Vulnerability Assessments for digital banking infrastructure.

Yes. Apex Global Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). Every policy within AGB, including Account Opening, Credit Cards, and KYC, is designed to be 100% compliant with the latest RBI Master Directions and circulars.

The bank is a Data Fiduciary, meaning it is responsible for keeping personal and financial data secure and using it only for the purposes for which the customer has provided consent, in compliance with the Information Technology Act and RBI's Cyber Security Framework.

The Right to Suitability means the bank will only offer products and services that are appropriate to the customer's financial needs and risk profile. The bank cannot push unsuitable financial products onto customers.

To open a savings account, submit an application digitally via V-KYC (ApexOne App) or at a branch, provide identity proof, address proof, and tax ID, and fund the initial deposit. The debit card is triggered automatically upon successful KYC verification. For new accounts, personalized cards are dispatched within 48 hours (3–5 business days to metro areas). The card is dispatched in an inactive state, so you must generate a Green PIN via the App, AGB ATM, or Net Banking to activate it.

If you don't update your KYC, your account will first face a partial freeze where outbound transactions including ATM withdrawals are blocked, which means your debit card will stop working for withdrawals. If the KYC remains pending for 6 months after a full freeze, the bank may close your account entirely.

If closing within 15 days to 1 year, a $20.00 closure fee applies. After 1 year, it is free. Any accrued AMB non-maintenance penalty ($25/month for Premium accounts) must be settled first. You must surrender or destroy checkbook leaves and debit card, ensure zero balance, and visit the branch. Remaining funds are transferred via wire or Manager's Check. Processing takes 3–5 business days.

International ATM transactions using a debit card incur a $5.00 flat fee plus a 2.5% currency conversion markup on the transaction amount. Additionally, international usage must be manually enabled on the card via the ApexOne App before it can be used abroad.

Report the unauthorized transaction within 72 hours for zero liability protection. The bank has 45–60 days to resolve debit card chargebacks. If unsatisfied, escalate through the Nodal Officer, then the Principal Nodal Officer. If unresolved after 30 days from initial complaint, you can approach the Banking Ombudsman. The bank uses AES-256 encryption and real-time fraud monitoring.

The AMB is calculated by summing daily closing balances divided by the number of days in the month. For Basic Savings, the required AMB is $500. Penalties are tiered: shortfall less than 25% costs $2/month, 25%–50% shortfall costs $4/month, and above 50% shortfall costs $5/month maximum. No penalty is applied in the first calendar month of opening.

No. Every credit card application undergoes a multi-layered screening process including KYC/Customer Due Diligence. An account with outdated KYC will be frozen, which prevents access to banking services and would disqualify you from credit card issuance since valid identity verification is mandatory for all credit applications.

For a Premium Savings account, there is no monthly maintenance fee but a $25/month penalty if AMB falls below $5,000. The Platinum Debit Card has a $50 annual fee (waived if annual spend exceeds $7,500), $0.50/quarter for SMS alerts, and a $2/quarter service fee is waived for Premium accounts. Fees will depend on whether you maintain the AMB and meet the spend waiver threshold.

With an annual income of $45,000, you meet the income threshold for the Apex Gold card ($40,000 minimum for salaried residents). Your credit score of 710 falls in Tier 2 (700–749), which allows standard processing. You may also be eligible for the Classic card ($15,000 minimum). The Platinum card requires a score of 750 and an income of $80,000, so you would not qualify for that. Ensure you have been employed for at least 6 months in your current job.

Name changes cannot be done digitally and require a physical visit to your home branch with original documents — a Marriage Certificate, Divorce Decree, or Government Gazette notification. After processing the name change, a new Debit Card is issued automatically with standard replacement fees of $15 applied. The overall process involves branch verification of documents.

Level 1 is Frontline — contact the specific touchpoint (branch, phone, app, email). Level 2 is the Regional Nodal Officer, contactable at nodal.officer@apexglobalbank.com with a 7 business day response time. Level 3 is the Principal Nodal Officer (PNO) at Corporate HQ, contactable at pno@apexglobalbank.com with a 10 business day response time. External escalation to the Banking Ombudsman is available after 30 days.

A dormant account (no transactions for 24 months) is fully blocked. To reactivate it, you need a written request, updated KYC documents, and biometric verification at the home branch. A dormant or blocked account would negatively affect your credit card application since the Internal Risk Rating (IRR) for existing AGB customers considers account activity, debit card usage, and digital banking frequency.
Apex Global Bank operates across 40 countries with a legacy spanning over five decades, serving over 15 million customers from its headquarters in a major financial hub.

KYC can be updated via the ApexOne App if there is no change in address or name (re-KYC only). Updates can also be done by email by sending self-attested scanned copies of new documents. For changes in signature or major profile updates, a branch visit is required. Address changes can be done digitally if the new address proof is a National ID linked to mobile OTP (instant); otherwise, branch visit takes 24–48 hours. Name changes must always be done in-branch.

Student account holders benefit from: zero initial deposit ($10 only), zero AMB requirement, no non-maintenance penalties, 100% waiver on annual card fees, 100% waiver on quarterly service fees, free e-statements, free internal AGB-to-AGB transfers, unlimited free AGB ATM usage, and zero account opening fee.
Source of Funds (SOF) declaration is mandatory for initial deposits exceeding $10,000 as part of the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorism Financing (CTF) compliance framework.

First, report the unauthorized transaction to the bank within 72 hours by calling 1-800-APEX-HELP or through the ApexOne App to block the card and initiate a Zero Liability dispute. Then raise a formal grievance via the Grievance Redressal portal. Credit card disputes are acknowledged within 48 hours with a resolution time of 15–45 business days. If unresolved satisfactorily after 30 days, escalate to Nodal Officer or approach the Banking Ombudsman.

FATCA stands for the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act. It requires applicants — particularly cross-border and non-resident applicants — to disclose their tax residency status to prevent cross-border tax evasion. Apex Global Bank complies with both FATCA and the Common Reporting Standard (CRS) for all international customers.

As a senior citizen aged 60 or above, you are eligible for the Senior Citizen Special savings account with a lower AMB of $250 and initial funding of just $100. You also receive a 50% discount on all non-maintenance penalties, a 50% waiver on all administrative and service request charges, and are eligible for a specialized savings account with benefits. Note: for credit cards, the maximum age at card expiry for salaried individuals is 65 years, so you may be limited in credit card options.

Apex Points is the debit card rewards program where you earn 1 point for every $5 spent on POS and online transactions. Platinum and Signature cardholders also receive complimentary quarterly visits to domestic airport lounges. Credit card rewards include up to 5x points on international spend for Apex Infinite cardholders.

To reactivate a dormant account (inactive for 24 months), you must: submit a written request to the bank, provide updated KYC documents including proof of address, and complete biometric verification (fingerprint or iris scan) at the home branch. A dormancy processing fee of $10 is charged. After reactivation, you will need to re-enable your debit card and may need to generate a new PIN.
Locker/Safe Deposit Box annual fees range from $50 to $500 per annum depending on the size, and are subject to availability.

Yes. Through the ApexOne app, you can independently toggle contactless payments on or off at any time via the Channel Management feature under Card Controls. You can also manage ATM, POS, and E-commerce channels separately.

If a nominee is registered on the account, the family member needs to submit a Death Certificate and Nominee ID to claim the funds. If no nominee is registered, a Succession Certificate or Letter of Administration is mandatory. The bank's legal team processes such claims, and digital access is not granted — all transactions must be done via branch-based requests.

The ApexOne app offers multiple card security features including: Temporary Lock (instantly disable/re-enable the card), Permanent Block for lost/stolen cards, Channel Management to independently toggle ATM/POS/E-commerce/Contactless, Merchant Category Blocking to restrict specific merchant types, Green PIN generation for new card activation, and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for mobile number and email updates.
The in-branch fee for notary or legal document verification is $25.00 per document.

The branch account opening process involves: (1) Consultation with a Relationship Manager who assesses your needs, (2) Form completion manually or via tablet-based application, (3) Physical Verification where original documents are scanned and returned, (4) Biometric Capture of fingerprint or iris scan, (5) KYC clearance and initial deposit, (6) Account activation. The process can result in an Instant Account within 30 minutes. A debit card is then automatically triggered and dispatched within 48 hours.

The RBI Master Direction on Know Your Customer (KYC) governs mandatory identity verification processes to prevent money laundering, ensuring that banks properly identify and verify their customers at account opening and periodically over time.

There are two types of account closure: Customer-Initiated Closure — where the customer submits a request via the ApexOne App (for zero-balance accounts) or at the home branch, surrenders checkbooks and cards, settles dues, and receives remaining funds via wire or Manager's Check. Bank-Initiated Closure — where the bank closes the account for KYC non-compliance after 6-month full freeze, verified involvement in fraudulent transactions, or 24 months of continuous zero balance with no activity. Bank closure requires 30 days' notice (for balance reasons).

The minimum annual income required for an expatriate to apply for the Apex Gold credit card is $60,000, along with a valid residence permit or visa with at least 12 months of validity and a stable local employment contract.
Daily transaction limits on debit cards are refreshed every 24 hours at 00:00 local time, resetting both ATM withdrawal limits and POS/online purchase limits.
The daily ATM withdrawal limit for a Signature (Elite) Debit Card is $5,000.
The contactless (tap and pay) limit for a Classic (Basic) Debit Card is $50 per transaction, subject to local regulatory caps.

After filing a grievance, you receive a unique Ticket Reference Number (TRN) which you can use to track the status. You can monitor the status via the ApexOne App under Help & Support, reference the TRN when calling 1-800-APEX-CARE, or email the support team. If the standard SLA has passed, you can escalate using the same TRN to the Nodal Officer.
The minimum annual income for a self-employed or expatriate applicant for the Apex Classic credit card is $30,000.

In the first year, potential charges include: no account opening fee, initial funding deposit (varies by account type), SMS alerts at $0.50/quarter, $2/quarter service fee for Basic accounts, ATM fees beyond 5 monthly non-AGB transactions ($2.50 each), international wire fees ($35 outbound, $15 inbound), debit card annual fee ($10 Classic, $50 Platinum, $150 Signature — waivable by spend), and AMB non-maintenance penalties if applicable. The first calendar month has no AMB penalty as a grace period.

Yes. Junior/Minor accounts can be opened for children under 18 years (ages 0–17). For children under 7, the account is guardian-controlled. Junior debit cards are issued for children aged 7–14, linked to a guardian's account with restricted limits.

A self-employed applicant for the Apex Platinum card (requiring $100,000 annual income for residents) needs: Primary ID (Passport or National ID), Secondary ID (Driver's License or Social Security Card), Address Proof (utility bills, lease agreement), Certified Balance Sheet and P&L statement for the last 2 years, Business License/Registration certificate, and 12 months of business bank statements. They must also have a minimum of 2 years of practice (for professionals) or 3 years of business vintage (for business owners).

The Liveness Check is an AI-driven facial recognition and liveness detection test performed during the digital account opening process to verify that the applicant is physically present and not using a photograph or video to spoof the system.
The minimum annual income required for an expatriate to apply for the Apex Infinite credit card is $350,000.

Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) and their associates are subject to Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), the highest level of KYC scrutiny. They also undergo additional credit card screening including sanctions screening against UN, OFAC, EU, and local jurisdiction watchlists. The bank may require additional documentation to verify their source of funds and wealth structure.

Tokenization is a security technology used in digital wallet transactions (Apple Pay/Google Pay) where actual card numbers are hidden and replaced with a unique token. This protects your real card number from being exposed during digital transactions, reducing the risk of fraud.

3D Secure is a mandatory second-factor authentication protocol for all online credit card transactions at Apex Global Bank. It provides an additional layer of security by requiring the cardholder to verify their identity during online purchases.

The following account types have no Average Monthly Balance (AMB) requirement: Student Savings accounts, Salary Savings accounts, Senior Citizen accounts opened under specific financial inclusion government schemes, and accounts during their first calendar month after opening (grace period for all account types).

Mystery Shopping is a compliance testing method used by Apex Global Bank where the bank conducts anonymous visits to physical branches to test the quality of service, fairness, and adherence to the Fair Practice Code in customer interactions.

Your AMB = (1000 × 10 + 0 × 20) / 30 = $333.33. The required AMB is $500. Your shortfall is $166.67, which is 33.3% of $500. This falls in the 25%–50% shortfall bracket, so you will be charged $4.00 for that month. Note: the first calendar month has no penalty as a grace period.

Most failed transactions are auto-reversed within 24–48 hours. Since it has been 4 days (more than 3 business days) without a reversal, you should raise a ticket via the Grievance Redressal portal immediately, providing your transaction reference ID. You can access this through the ApexOne App, by calling 1-800-APEX-CARE, or by emailing support@apexglobalbank.com.

After 6 months of full freeze without KYC update, the bank has the right to close your account and issue a Manager's Check for your remaining balance. At 7 months, your account may already have been closed. You should contact the bank immediately to check the status and provide updated KYC documents to resolve this.

You get 5 free transactions per month at non-AGB ATMs. The 6th and 7th transactions are each charged at $2.50. So for your 7th transaction, you will be charged $2.50. Your total extra ATM charges for the month so far are $5.00 (2 transactions × $2.50).

A 14-year-old cannot have their own independent savings account (minimum age is 18 for standard accounts). However, they can get a Junior Card issued for ages 7–14, linked to a guardian's account with restricted limits. For a personalized debit card in their own name, they must be at least 15 years old.

You would need to reduce your monthly debt obligations relative to your income before reapplying. A DTI between 30–45% is subject to senior underwriter review, and below 30% is considered ideal.

You cannot close your savings account while you have an outstanding credit card bill. All linked credit facilities — including credit card dues — must be fully settled or transferred to another account before the savings account can be closed. You must first pay off or transfer your credit card balance, then initiate the closure process.

At 45 days overdue, your account is past the Day 30 'Past Due Date' marking (when credit bureau reporting started) and card privileges are being temporarily suspended at Day 60. A recovery agent may contact you during this time, but only between 08:00 and 19:00. No harassment or breach of privacy is permitted under AGB's Code of Commitment to Customers, and dispute resolution channels remain available 24/7.

At Day 60 of non-payment, your credit card privileges are temporarily suspended. By Day 30, the account was already marked Past Due Date (PDD) and credit bureau reporting had been initiated. At Day 90, the account will be classified as a Non-Performing Asset (NPA) and legal proceedings will be initiated.
Address changes made via the Mobile App are free of charge. The $5.00 fee only applies to address changes made through a physical branch visit.

An Officially Valid Document (OVD) is a government-recognized document accepted by Apex Global Bank for KYC purposes. For identity proof, OVDs include Passport, National Identity Card, Driver's License, and Voter ID. For address proof, OVDs include Utility Bills (not more than 3 months old), Property Tax Receipt, Bank Statement, and Registered Lease Agreement.

A velocity check is a fraud detection mechanism that monitors and flags accounts with an unusually high number of transactions within a short time period. It is part of Apex Global Bank's real-time Fraud Management System (FMS) to detect potentially fraudulent activity.

A credit card account is classified as a Non-Performing Asset (NPA) when payment is overdue by 90 days. At this point, legal proceedings are initiated. This follows Day 30 (Past Due Date marking and credit bureau reporting) and Day 60 (temporary suspension of card privileges).
Elite and Signature cardholders do not pay any card replacement fee — it is waived as part of the premium benefits package. For other cardholders, the standard replacement fee is $15 per instance.

OCR stands for Optical Character Recognition. It is used in digital credit card applications via the ApexOne mobile app and web portal to automatically extract and process information from uploaded documents, minimizing manual data entry during the application process.
A shortfall of exactly 25% falls in the 25%–50% penalty bracket (since the tiers are: less than 25%, 25%–50%, and above 50%). You will be charged $4.00 per month.
For legal and compliance matters, the contact is compliance@apexbank.int with internal extension 205.
Yes. Customers can lower their debit card transaction limits via the ApexOne App for enhanced security. You can independently manage and reduce ATM, POS, E-commerce, and Contactless channel limits.

Approximately 40% of credit card applications are Straight-Through Processed (STP) by the Automated Credit Decisioning (ACD) engine, meaning they are processed and approved automatically without any manual intervention.

Yes. Both mobile number and email address (contact details) can be updated at any AGB ATM or via the Mobile App using Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). Changing the registered mobile number will temporarily disable high-value digital transfers for 24 hours.

The daily ATM withdrawal limit for a Platinum (Premium) Debit Card is $2,000. Limits are refreshed every 24 hours at 00:00 local time. To exceed this limit, you would need to upgrade to a Signature (Elite) card, which has a $5,000 daily ATM withdrawal limit.

Geo-tagging in the Video KYC (V-KYC) process is a verification step that records and confirms the geographical location of the customer at the time of completing KYC, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and preventing fraudulent applications from prohibited jurisdictions.

For an outbound international wire transfer, you will pay a flat fee of $35.00. If you are using a debit card at an international ATM to withdraw the funds abroad, there is also a $5.00 flat fee plus a 2.5% currency conversion markup on the amount. For the full $50,000 international transfer, the fee is $35.00 via the Global Wire section in Net Banking.

The Internal Risk Rating (IRR) is used by Apex Global Bank to evaluate existing customers for credit card applications. It assesses the Average Monthly Balance (AMB) over the last 12 months, history of loan repayments, and usage frequency of debit cards and digital banking to determine creditworthiness.

The Automated Credit Decisioning (ACD) engine is a proprietary system used by Apex Global Bank during credit card applications. It performs instant checks against internal Negative Lists and credit bureau data, and approximately 40% of applications are Straight-Through Processed (STP) by this engine without manual intervention.

The Green PIN is the initial PIN that a customer must set to activate their new debit card. It is called Green PIN because it is set for the first time. Cards are dispatched in an inactive state and the Green PIN must be generated via the ApexOne App, any AGB ATM, or Net Banking before the card can be used.
The Regional Nodal Officer can be contacted at nodal.officer@apexglobalbank.com. The response time is 7 business days.

Yes, but only for non-sensitive preliminary assistance. You can send a Direct Message (DM) to Apex Global Bank's official verified handles on X (Twitter) or Facebook. For sensitive issues involving account details or financial matters, use the secure channels — ApexOne App, email, phone banking, or branch visit.

Employment Verification for credit card applications is done through official email confirmation from the employer or HR tele-verification. This is part of Stage 3 of the operational workflow (Verification stage) which also includes Residence Verification via physical visit or geo-tagged photo verification.

No, this is incorrect. Apex Global Bank has a First-Month Grace Period policy where no AMB penalties are levied during the first full calendar month of account opening. The customer should file a grievance requesting reversal of this charge, and the bank should reverse it. The customer can do this through the ApexOne App under Help & Support or by calling 1-800-APEX-CARE.

CRS stands for Common Reporting Standard, not Counterfeit Reporting Standard. It is an international standard for automatic exchange of financial account information between tax authorities. Apex Global Bank complies with CRS along with FATCA, requiring applicants — especially non-residents — to disclose their tax residency status to prevent cross-border tax evasion.

For rural or regional areas, a personalized debit card takes 7 to 10 business days to be delivered after it is dispatched. The card is dispatched within 48 hours of account activation (post-KYC verification), so you can expect the card within approximately 9–12 business days from today. You will need to generate a Green PIN to activate the card upon receipt.

Apex Global Bank recommends that customers check the Last Login timestamp every time they enter Net Banking as part of the digital safety checklist, to detect any unauthorized access to their account.
The Principal Nodal Officer (PNO) can be contacted at pno@apexglobalbank.com at the Corporate Headquarters. The response time is 10 business days.

The standard APR on Apex credit cards is 3.5% per month, which equals 42% per annum. For customers with credit scores above 800, a preferred APR of 1.5% to 2.5% per month is available. Cash advances accrue interest immediately at 3.99% per month.

New debit cards are enabled for domestic usage only by default. E-commerce and online transactions must be manually enabled through the ApexOne mobile app. Go to Card Controls and toggle on the E-commerce/Online Transactions channel. This also helps prevent unauthorized cross-border fraud on your card.

The Maximum Credit Limit (MCL) — not Minimum — is determined by credit officers based on three factors: the applicant's income, their risk score (from credit bureaus and internal assessment), and existing credit exposure across other banks. This happens in Stage 4 (Underwriting and Limit Setting) of the credit card application process.

Yes. Apex Global Bank recommends enabling biometric login on the ApexOne App as part of the digital safety checklist. This provides an additional layer of security for accessing your banking services.

Geographic anomaly detection is part of Apex Global Bank's real-time Fraud Management System (FMS). It flags suspicious patterns such as a card being used in two different countries within an hour, which is physically impossible and indicates potential fraud.

At Day 90 of non-payment, regardless of the card type (including Apex Infinite), the account is classified as a Non-Performing Asset (NPA) and legal proceedings are initiated. Prior to this, at Day 30 credit bureau reporting was initiated, and at Day 60 card privileges were temporarily suspended.
The customer service support email for Apex Global Bank is support@apexglobalbank.com.

The dormancy activation fee is $10.00, charged as a one-time fee when an account transitions from Inactive (no transactions for 12 months) to Dormant status (no transactions for 24 months). This is different from the reactivation process fee.

The SWIFT/BIC code is the unique identifier for the destination bank required when making international wire transfers through the Global Wire section in Net Banking. You also need the recipient's IBAN or Account Number.
There is no limit — ATM usage at Apex Global Bank's own network of over 5,000 global ATMs is completely free with unlimited transactions for AGB customers.

A score of 700–749 (Tier 2) results in standard processing but may require additional scrutiny. You also need to be employed for at least 6 months in your current job, with 1 year total career experience, at a registered corporate, government body, or reputed MNC.

AI algorithms monitor the first 30 days of activity on a new savings account for suspicious patterns as part of the fraud prevention measures during account onboarding.

Apex Global Bank adheres to strict data protection laws including GDPR and local privacy laws. All customer PII (Personally Identifiable Information) is encrypted at rest and in transit using AES-256. Data is never shared with third parties except for regulatory reporting or credit bureau assessments.

If you close your account on Day 14, you are within the Free Look period and there is no closure fee — it is completely free. If you close it on Day 15, the Free Look period has ended and a $20.00 administrative fee applies. So the difference between Day 14 and Day 15 closure is $20.00.

Partial KYC accounts have a limited validity of 12 months. Since your account is 13 months old, the Partial KYC validity has already expired. You need to complete Full KYC immediately to continue using the account. Without Full KYC update, the account faces a partial freeze first (blocking outbound transactions), and if KYC remains pending, progressively stricter restrictions up to account closure after 6 months of full freeze.
